verdict.rationale: Netlify claims automatic DDoS protection on its platform (netlify-docs-9). It also references a higher-tier 'Netlify Advanced Security' offering (netlify-docs-18), but the evidence never shows a web application firewall applied to every request by default. A concrete community report of a static site being billed $104k after a DDoS (netlify-comm-1, netlify-comm-2) shows that attack traffic was served and billed, which weakens how effective the default DDoS mitigation is in practice. Missing for 10: any documented WAF, confirmation that WAF/DDoS protection covers every request by default on all plans, details of how the DDoS protection works, and independent corroboration that attacks are actually absorbed.
